---

New tasks never enter v0.1, which is frozen. Accepted proposals are collected for a future version.

**Failure family** (one of the ten in METHODOLOGY.md, or a new one with a definition)

**Analyst question**

**Evidence** (what the tools return; dataset, version, status, observability). Use public or synthetic values only. Nothing that identifies a real property.

**Supported conclusion**

**Unsupported conclusions the task is meant to catch**

**Why existing tasks do not cover it**

**Data source terms** (license of any dataset the evidence derives from)
